name: facebook_friends_graph
summary: Friends-graph harvester for the MySpace++ social graph. Companion to facebook_games_sdk.py (which owns the dev surface). Single purpose: given a user_access_token + player_id, fetch the consenting friends list from /me/friends OR consume the FBInstant.player.getConnectedPlayersAsync payload, normalize each record into {player_id, friend_player_id, friend_name, friend_picture_url, friend_app_active, captured_at, source, signed}, then forward each edge to social_graph_persistence.upsert_edge (graceful no-op while agent F's module is still landing). Every successful harvest crystal-anchors via inference_logger.log(tier='social_graph', model='facebook_friends_graph', scope='friends_harvest'). Stdlib-only — no requests, no facebook-sdk package. Graceful degrade everywhere: missing FB_APP_ID/SECRET → verify_credentials + graph_api harvest return SendResult(success=False) WITHOUT hitting the network; missing user_access_token → graceful 400 with explanatory error; missing social_graph_persistence → persistence becomes a no-op (recorded in the body anyway) and friend_of_friend / nearby_active_friends return empty lists with explanatory notes.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass mirroring facebook_games_sdk shape. SERVICE='facebook_friends'. Dispatcher routes recipient → private _tool method; each returns (status, body) and the dispatcher wraps in SendResult. /me/friends is paginated via the body.paging.next cursor with MAX_PAGES=50 hard cap. appsecret_proof is auto-attached to every /me/* call when both FB_APP_SECRET and user_access_token are present (FB server-call best practice). Permission gate runs BEFORE any /me/friends call: check_permissions is invoked internally and must report scope_user_friends_granted=True or harvest refuses with HTTP 403 + error='user_friends_scope_not_granted'.

safety_rail.policy: NEVER harvest /me/friends without explicit user_friends scope granted via FB OAuth + a checkbox on the terms page.
enforcement: 2. If /me/permissions does not list user_friends with status='granted', harvest_for returns SendResult(success=False, error='user_friends_scope_not_granted') and makes NO call to /me/friends.
3. /me/friends ITSELF only returns friends who have also authorized our app (platform policy enforced server-side by Meta since Graph API v2.0).
4. fb_instant source consumes the payload returned by FBInstant.player.getConnectedPlayersAsync — players the SDK already filtered to 'connected and uses our game'.
5. revoke_check is provided so callers can detect token revocation (OAuthException code 190 / HTTP 401) and immediately stop harvesting for that user.
safety_rail.consent_policy: Harvest ONLY after user_friends scope is granted via FB OAuth and the user has ticked the explicit consent checkbox on the MySpace++ terms-of-service page. The checkbox text must name the harvest scope plainly ("share my Facebook friends who also use this app") — generic ToS acceptance is NOT sufficient. If the checkbox is unticked, the calling surface MUST NOT pass the token to this connector. If user_friends is revoked later (via FB account settings or our app), revoke_check returns token_valid=False and the harvest loop must halt and mark all previously persisted edges for the player as 'consent_withdrawn' at the social_graph_persistence layer.
safety_rail.data_minimization: We persist {friend_player_id, friend_name, friend_picture_url, friend_app_active, captured_at, source, signed} only. We do NOT persist locale, gender, age, email, or any other Graph field — even if Meta returns them.
safety_rail.redaction: access_token, user_access_token, appsecret_proof, app_secret, signed_player_info, and raw payload are stripped from the crystal-anchor record before logging.

env_vars.FB_APP_ID: Facebook App ID (developers.facebook.com/apps → App Settings → Basic). Required for appsecret_proof signing.
env_vars.FB_APP_SECRET: Facebook App Secret. Required for appsecret_proof signing on /me/* calls (FB server-call best practice).
env_vars.FB_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN: Optional fallback user-OAuth token for CLI usage. Production callers should pass the token per-call via send(..., user_access_token=<t>).
env_vars.FB_GRAPH_API_BASE: Full base URL override (skips version composition)

user_provisioning_required.rationale: Shares FB_APP_ID and FB_APP_SECRET with facebook_games_sdk. The user_access_token is per-call (per-player) and supplied by the OAuth flow at runtime — not stored in .env in production. Until FB_APP_ID and FB_APP_SECRET are added the connector will graceful-fail every network call without any HTTP request.
how_to_obtain: 1. Visit https://developers.facebook.com/apps — same app used by facebook_games_sdk.
2. App Dashboard → Settings → Basic → App ID + App Secret.
3. App Review → Permissions → request 'user_friends' (standard access). Meta requires this review for ALL non-developer-tester accounts.

4. Implement the OAuth flow on the calling surface (studio/dapp/server.py or the FBInstant SDK init): request scope 'user_friends' along with whatever else you need, then pass the resulting user_access_token per-call to harvest_for.

convenience_wrappers: harvest_for(user_access_token, player_id, source='graph_api'|'fb_instant', payload?, signed_player_info?) — primary entry; paginates /me/friends OR consumes connected_players; persists each edge; returns metadata.friends_count + new_friends_count + error_for_oauth_revoked
revoke_check(user_access_token) — GET /me?fields=id; surfaces token_valid bool + error_for_oauth_revoked when OAuthException code 190 / HTTP 401
friend_of_friend(player_id, depth=2) — queries social_graph_persistence.query_edges; graceful empty list when module absent
nearby_active_friends(player_id, geo_radius_km=50) — queries social_graph_persistence.query_geo_friends; graceful empty list + note when geo unknown
verify_credentials() — read-only smoke; confirms FB_APP_ID + FB_APP_SECRET present; NO network call
substrate: studio/third_party/facebook_friends/ (per-config persistence) + ~/.cc/third_party_logs/facebook_friends_sends.jsonl (history) + ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (crystal-anchored social_graph records, tier='social_graph', model='facebook_friends_graph') + social_graph_persistence DB (edges; agent F is building this)

inbound_callers: studio/dapp/server.py (FBInstant webhook handler — POST connected_players after FBInstant.player.getConnectedPlayersAsync resolves client-side)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: FB_APP_ID + FB_APP_SECRET + FB_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN + FB_GRAPH_API_VERSION + FB_GRAPH_API_BASE via studio/auth/keys.load_env
routing_connections.substrate_writes: send_log entries + crystal_chain social_graph records (only when keys present + call succeeds, OR for local-only friend_of_friend/nearby_active_friends queries) + social_graph DB edges (when social_graph_persistence is importable)

companions.facebook_games_sdk: Sibling connector — owns the developer surface (debug_token, send_app_event, register_instant_game, leaderboard_get, notification_send, graph_get_me, app_secret_proof_compute). This module does NOT duplicate any of those tools.
companions.social_graph_persistence: Agent F is building this in core/lib/social_graph_persistence.py. Until it lands the persistence calls become no-ops (logged to stderr as a warning only if upsert raises); harvest_for still returns the normalized friends list in body.friends so callers can use it directly.

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every successful harvest event has a deterministic InferenceRecord with tier='social_graph', model='facebook_friends_graph', scope='friends_harvest'
Consent-first — user_friends scope MUST be granted before /me/friends is called; check_permissions is invoked internally as a gate
Stdlib-only — no `facebook-sdk` or `requests` package required; uses urllib (GET only — harvest is pure read)
Graceful — missing FB_APP_ID/FB_APP_SECRET → all network tools return SendResult(success=False) WITHOUT any HTTP request
Graceful persistence — social_graph_persistence ImportError is caught; persistence becomes a no-op and the normalized friends list is still returned in body.friends
Paginated + bounded — /me/friends pagination follows body.paging.next with MAX_PAGES=50 hard cap to prevent runaway harvests
Auto-proof — appsecret_proof auto-attached to every /me/* request when FB_APP_SECRET + user_access_token are both present
Redacted logs — access_token, user_access_token, appsecret_proof, app_secret, signed_player_info, raw payload are stripped from the crystal-anchor record
Token-revoke aware — revoke_check + harvest_for both surface error_for_oauth_revoked=True when OAuthException code 190 / HTTP 401 is returned

Data minimization — only {friend_player_id, friend_name, friend_picture_url, friend_app_active, captured_at, source, signed} are persisted; locale/gender/age/email are NOT persisted even when Meta returns them
Dual-source — graph_api (server-side OAuth flow) AND fb_instant (FBInstant SDK client-side callback) both supported via the same harvest_for entry
usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.facebook_friends_graph import FacebookFriendsGraphConnector
c = FacebookFriendsGraphConnector()
# graph_api path (server-side OAuth flow)
perm = c.send('check_permissions', json.dumps({'user_access_token': uat}))
if perm.metadata.get('scope_user_friends_granted'):
    r = c.send('harvest_for', json.dumps({
        'user_access_token': uat,
        'player_id': 'fb_42',
        'source': 'graph_api',
    }))
    print(r.metadata['friends_count'], r.crystal_id)
# fb_instant path (called from the FBInstant SDK postback)
r2 = c.send('harvest_for', json.dumps({
    'user_access_token': '',
    'player_id': 'fb_42',
    'source': 'fb_instant',
    'signed_player_info': signed_blob,
    'payload': {'connected_players': connected_players_array},
}))
print(r2.metadata['friends_count'], r2.crystal_id)
